_note: A case type's fields are listed in the order the functional administrator gives them (DqZaaktypeVelden: "Sleep om de volgorde te wijzigen"). The Fields tab drags a row to another place and writes only this number, so the order is the type's own and the same in the case's form and the list. A fragment rather than an edit to dossiq_register.json, per ADR-037.

order.title: Order
order.description: The field's place in its case type's list of fields, from 1. A field without one is listed after those that have one.
